title: Evidence Report Metadata
description: Schema for structured metadata indexing markdown evidence reports without embedding the full markdown body.

evidence_report_id.description: Unique identifier for this evidence report metadata record.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this evidence_report_metadata payload.

report_ref.description: Path or stable reference to the markdown report. The report body is not embedded.

report_hash.description: Report hash in sha256 format (with optional 'sha256:' prefix).

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when this metadata record was created.

source_version_refs.description: Referenced source_version identifiers used to produce this evidence report.

review_manifest_ref.description: Reference to the associated review_manifest identifier.

approved_artifact_ref.description: Reference to the associated approved_artifact identifier.

jurisdiction_scope.description: Jurisdictions covered by this evidence report.

risk_level.description: Risk level associated with the evidence report.

human_review_required.description: Whether human review is required before downstream usage.

limitations.description: Known limitations for this evidence report metadata entry.

summary.description: Optional short summary of the evidence report.

affected_codes.description: Optional list of affected nomenclature/regulatory codes.

profile_context_used.description: Optional profile context identifiers used during report preparation.

evidence_refs.description: Optional evidence artifact references related to this report.

valid_until.description: Optional timestamp until this metadata record is valid.
